profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Domo, Inc.
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer and DevOps leader with 30+ years of experience architecting, building, and operating large-scale enterprise platforms. Proven expertise in multi-cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, software distribution, and site reliability across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. Led cross-functional teams and delivered mission-critical systems supporting global customers, high availability requirements, and secure software entitlement.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and developed internal platforms supporting customer administration, operational workflows, and account lifecycle management.

Led multi-cloud migration initiatives across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI, securely transferring hundreds of terabytes of data while minimizing customer disruption.

Designed CI/CD automation platforms that streamlined deployment orchestration across development and production environments.

Created technical processes for effective interoperability between independent systems.

Built deployment systems supporting dozens of services and hundreds of production releases monthly.

Developed and operated Domo's real-time public service health platform, improving customer visibility during incidents.

Automated security certificate management and infrastructure maintenance processes, reducing operational overhead and improving security posture.

Participated in on-call incident response, maintaining high availability for business-critical services.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Automation · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Software Architecture · System Monitoring · Spring Boot · JavaScript · Oracle Cloud · Cloud Storage · Cloud Computing · Kubernetes · Docker · Kotlin · Site Reliability Engineering · AngularJS · Redis · GitHub · Linux · TypeScript · Python · Jira · Web Development · React.js · Microsoft Azure · Security · Git · MySQL · Domain Name System (DNS) · Java · DevOps · Jenkins · SSL Certificates · Go (Programming Language) · Bash · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js

positions.title: Senior Systems Design Specialist, Team Lead, Assistant Development Delivery Manager
positions.description:
Delivered dedicated software engineering support for mission-critical client web platforms.

Led distributed engineering teams across multiple geographic regions, coordinating delivery, operational support, and incident response.

Coordinated project execution, operational support, and incident management processes.

Managed project tracking, issue resolution, and incident response.

Collaborated with leadership on key personnel and organizational decisions.

Worked with client stakeholders to enhance critical enterprise systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Team Management · Oracle Database · Site Reliability Engineering · SQL · Software Engineering · Java · Project Management

positions.title: Senior Web Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Served as primary architect and technical lead for multiple enterprise
software platforms.

Designed and developed Novell's global software download platform and
backend provisioning system.

Built systems for software distribution, entitlement validation, content
management, and access control, earning a U.S. patent.

Integrated delivery systems with financial licensing and customer
management platforms.

Developed scalable storage architectures supporting terabytes of software
content. Eliminated file duplication while maintaining efficient distribution
capabilities.

Implemented file archiving and backup systems for data integrity.

Automated customer entitlement validation based on subscriptions,
licensing, and purchase history.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Enterprise Storage · Site Reliability Engineering · SQL · Patent Inventor · Linux · Software Engineering · Software Distribution · Backup & Recovery Systems · Deduplication · Java · Bash · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description:
Pioneered development and shaped technical direction as the first software
engineer hired at Omniture.

Established engineering practices during formative years, fostering growth
and best practices.

Team lead and chief developer for SuperStats web analytics platform.

Directed team in creating AdRunner online advertising platform.

Contributed to foundational products that supported Omniture's long-term
success.

Influenced technical direction and engineering culture through leadership
and initiative.

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description: Developed early website and software for the Technology Transfer Office.  Also designed and implemented an XML-like database and shopping cart website for the Office of Creative Works.  Both consisted of Perl CGI scripts hosted on Apache web servers in the early days of the Internet.
